data.name: Aliah
data.gender_notes: Aliah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Exalted, Sublime, Noble in Allah's sight, One who is lofty in position and rank. The name Aliah carries the meaning “Exalted, Sublime, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aliah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is close to Allah and has a high level of spiritual awareness.
data.etymology: Aliah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Sublime, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aliah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عالية
in_arabic.meaning: الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و المكانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عاليا مشتق من العلو و الرفعة، و يعني الارتفاع في الشأن و المكانة، و هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الرفعة و العزة في الإسلام، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الإسراء: «وَلِلَّهِ الْعُلُوُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ»

in_urdu.name: عالیا
in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و بلندی کا اظہار کرنے والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالیا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت، بلندی، و عزت، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کی گئی صفات کے مطابق ہے

in_hindi.name: आलिया
in_hindi.meaning: उन्नति और उच्चता की अभिव्यक्ति करने वाला नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: आलिया नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं में हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्चता, उन्नति और समृद्धि, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसे पवित्र और शुभ माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: عالیا
in_pashto.meaning: د لوړتوب او عزت څرګندولو نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عالیا نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لوړتوب، عزت او ویاړ دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مهم دی، او د اسلامي ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري

in_english.name: Aliah
in_english.meaning: Exalted, noble, and high-status name in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aliah originates from the Arabic root 'ʿ-l-w' which means 'to rise' or 'to ascend', conveying the meanings of exaltation, nobility, and high status, referenced in the Quran (17:33) as an attribute of Allah, signifying elevation and transcendence

data.cultural_impact: The name Aliah holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic community as it symbolizes the lofty and noble character of those who bear it. This name is often given to children who are considered as a blessings from Allah, and are expected to uphold noble values and virtues.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aliah signifies one's devotion and closeness to Allah. It is a constant reminder for the bearer to strive towards pleasing Allah and living a life that is worthy of His sublime and noble character. The name also signifies the seeker's aspiration to be exalted and elevated in Allah's sight, ultimately achieving His endless mercy and blessings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Exalted, Sublime, Noble" symbolizes Exalted, Sublime, Noble in Allah's sight, One who is lofty in position and rank.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aliah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of exalted, sublime, noble.

islamic_reference.note: Cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), fourth Caliph

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aliah was a daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aliah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aliah was one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in various Hadiths.
